first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: A man with short black hair, a white long-sleeved shirt, and a narrow red tie, crouched at the lower left at the beginning of the clip, then raising his body and moving forward.

entities.name: Person I
entities.identification: A woman wearing a blue lapelled top and a pink knotted headscarf, positioned behind the open Vehicle E's front door at the beginning of the clip.

entities.name: queue of vehicles in traffic congestion
entities.identification: The collection of other vehicles densely arrayed around and behind the main people, excluding Vehicle E and Vehicle F, which are listed separately in this clip.

entities.name: clear blue sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of light blue sky above the people and vehicles.

entities.name: Vehicle E
entities.identification: The dark gray reflective sedan on the right referenced by the items in this clip; its open front door is pushed back by Person I at the beginning of the clip, and its side window, roofline, and exterior side mirror are visible at the end of the clip.

entities.name: Vehicle F
entities.identification: The taller dark blue-gray vehicle behind and to the image-right of Person I, with a broad dark windshield and a roof rack.

entities.name: surrounding crowd
entities.identification: The collection of other people behind Person F and Person I, among the line of vehicles and extending above the vehicle roofs, excluding these two main people.

entities.name: Vehicle E's front door
entities.identification: The dark front door pushed by Person I, with a glass side window and curved window frame; it is open at the beginning of the clip and closed against the side of Vehicle E by the end of the clip.
